# FreeAudioScene <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
FreeAudioScene:Void scene:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scene` | In | Int32 | required | A scene from [CreateAudioScene](CreateAudioScene). `0` is ignored. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Frees an audio scene. What it set stays where it is. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
FreeAudioScene space
```
